scope: Connect existing original QuantObservationJournal read-only export to C27/C28 source-obligation evidence; freeze balanced eight-arm one-financed-account experimental schedule; require actual C25-C26 source NAV/quotes/FILL evidence for descriptive return; provide conditional sharp-null exact sign-flip randomization with six-family Holm. Never generate signals, market seeds, accounts, broker orders or certify economic GO from source-only fixtures.

source_connections.native_Journal: runtime30/quant_observations.js exportFrames/view called read-only; original quant_bridge.cjs observationInput uses plugin 'observation-only' and rotates symbols, so it DOES NOT produce all six C22 policy prefilter evaluations
source_connections.warning: Native read-only adapter functional in tests with original Journal class, but NOT deployed/connected to user's live Render service or authenticated broker. All six-arm generator hooks currently uninstrumented.

pre_registration.registered_at_requirement: At least 72h before first block; independent time anchor not supplied or assumed
pre_registration.randomization: Every one of eight arms occurs exactly once in every cycle. Deterministic unbiased Fisher-Yates with domain-separated SHA256 from user-provided fixed commitment nonce; seed does not generate market data or investment signals.
pre_registration.cash_account: single continuously financed initial $20,000, no secondary account resets, external flows disallowed

statistical_method.estimand: Cycle-specific daily log wealth difference for one assigned variant vs assigned CASH and original baseline, normalized by six-day active+washout block horizon.
statistical_method.conditional_pairwise_test: Under pairwise sharp no-effect null, fixed potential outcomes, legitimate randomized arm assignments, no cross-block carry/interference, each cycle's arm/control assignment labels are exchangeable; flip the within-cycle contrast sign. Enumerate all 2^cycle sign patterns through 18 cycles, else deterministic 19999-sample randomization diagnostic with +1.
statistical_method.intersection_union: For each of six variants need positive advantage versus both controls; combine p_i=max(p_i_vsCash,p_i_vsOriginal).
statistical_method.multiple_tests: Holm familywise 0.025 across six intersection-union hypotheses, not 78 five-minute bars independently treated.
statistical_method.minimum_p_bound: For 4 cycles the one-sided best possible p=1/16=0.0625 and no Holm six-family rejection is possible; 8 cycles permits 1/256*6=0.0234375 under perfect sign-aligned data.
statistical_method.limits: Even a small p under sharp null does not establish a population effect lower confidence bound under heterogeneous treatment effects, no time interference, conditional execution attainability, causal source signing or profitable net growth. Report sharp-null tests as DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY until independently authenticated.
statistical_method.power_analysis_beyond_design: Not performed; 8 cycles is an algebraic lower bound on attainable p-value, not a power guarantee.

coverage_and_provenance.five_minute_grid: Every 5-min UTC slot (including cryptocurrency overnight and washout) between first assigned start and last funding review must be in immutable C27+C28 source journals; 4-cycle pilot 55,680 records, 8-cycle inference minimum >60,000 and requires multiple segmented journals.
coverage_and_provenance.native_source_completeness: Caller-provided asset registry and QuantObservationJournal rotating 'observation-only' records never prove six original research variants were actually evaluated before filters; original generator still requires instrumentation/independent source tap.
coverage_and_provenance.C25_C26_economic_evidence: Each planned block must supply account baseline+terminal, all orders/activities FILL/FEE/cash, actual source quote/decision/receipt stamps. Cash and initial/final positions must be flat, order/fill within the 72h trade interval, no queue claim, no outside costs outside NAV until payable separately reconciled.
coverage_and_provenance.financial_claims: Always false with connected source-only tools. User private Alpaca Trading API and Render runtime not accessible from current project connectors.
